description: List every award given at every event in a district season, including the district championship. Returns award records (name, type code, event key, year, recipient team keys and individual awardees). Use to tally district-wide award winners in one call instead of calling get_event_awards per event.

district_key.description: TBA district key combining the season year and district abbreviation (e.g., '2023fim' for FIRST in Michigan, '2024ne' for New England, '2024chs' for Chesapeake, '2024pnw' for Pacific Northwest, '2024fit' for FIRST In Texas). Use get_districts to enumerate valid district keys for a year.

name: get_district_awards
title: List Awards in a District
